title: Some wonder whether Dolphins will take full $99.2 million cap charge for Tua Tagovailoa in 2026

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Some wonder whether Dolphins will take full $99.2 million cap charge for Tua Tagovailoa in 2026
sources.description: The Dolphins could clear Tagovailoa from the books this year, but he'd count for nearly 33 percent of the cap.
